name: Mexican Enchilada Bake
description: A hearty, layered casserole featuring chicken, tortillas, and a rich tomato-salsa sauce, topped with cheese and sour cream.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups tomato sauce or ¾ cup each diced carrots and diced canned tomatoes
1 can (19 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Combine tomato sauce, salsa, 2 teaspoons chili powder, and 2 teaspoons cumin in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken, rice, beans, carrots, red pepper, onion, lime juice, cilantro, remaining 2 teaspoons chili powder, and remaining 1 teaspoon cumin.
Spray a 9×13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
To assemble the casserole, spread 1 cup of sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange 6 tortillas over the bottom, overlapping as necessary.
Spoon another 1 cup of sauce over the tortillas and spread evenly. Top with half of the bean mixture and half of the cheese.
Arrange the remaining tortillas, top with another 1 cup of sauce, followed by the remaining bean mixture and remaining cheese.
Spoon any remaining sauce over the top. Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and heated through.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Top individual servings with a dollop of sour cream.

keywords: enchilada bake, Mexican casserole, chicken recipe

_similar.name: Tortilla Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.

_similar.keywords: tortilla soup, Mexican soup, chicken soup, spicy soup

_similar.name: Taco Twist Bake
_similar.description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Fairest Wheels
_similar.description: A chilled, rolled tortilla snack filled with a spicy chicken and cheese mixture.
recipeIngredient: ⅔ cup chopped green bell pepper
⅓ cup minced green onions and red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, cheddar cheese.
In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sour cream together until smooth.
Add the cream cheese mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well.
Spread ⅓ cup of the chicken and cream cheese mixture onto one side of a tortilla, leaving a ½-inch border at the top.
Sprinkle with ⅓ cup shredded cheese and top with red pepper jelly.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and seal the edge.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling mixture.
Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Trim the ends off each roll and cut into 8 slices.
Serve cold.

_similar.keywords: chicken roll-ups, cheese snack, cold appetizer
